limits: Three original T38.06 criterion/V1 pairs; actual author implementation and bounded observations, not learner mastery.
Actual frozen PsSpi/PuRates/algo_ring/sd_spi_edge and F439 adapter; MPS2 executes Thumb and a real software-pended CPU IRQ with RAM register models, not physical SPI or DMA.
Selected newlib headers are compilation inputs only; retained firmware has no libc/libm/compiler-runtime link. Unused algorithms are discarded and not claimed validated.
Finite two-slot scheduler, serialization and caller-controlled time; no fairness, interrupt latency, all-interleaving or hard termination guarantee.
Physical dedicated-peer timing, electrical loading and board routing remain required, along with external review and independent delayed learner attempts.
